notes: MH4U blademaster constants. True raw = displayed attack / coefficient. rawModifiers are conditional peak multipliers, not always-on: SnS 1.06 applies to sword attacks (shield attacks excluded); DB 1.15 applies only in Demon Mode (1.0 otherwise); SA 1.2 applies only to sword-mode attacks with a Power Phial (1.0 in axe mode and for other phials); MH4U Gunlance has no class-wide 0.97 raw modifier (that is MHFU/MHP2G) and is 1.0, with only action modifiers: full burst 1.1 Normal / 0.9 Spread, charged shell 1.2 Normal+Long / 1.45 Spread, and Long Wyvern Fire 1.2. Sharpness+1 is Handicraft +10; MH4U has no Sharpness+2 (it appears from Generations/GenU onward). Honed Blade (Edgemaster +10) grants Sharpness+1 plus Attack Up (L), i.e. +20 true raw. Purple is 1.45 raw / 1.20 element and white is 1.32 / 1.125; Sharpness+1 is what normally unlocks purple on G-rank weapons. Element Atk Up is 1.1x all five elements. Single-element +1/+2/+3 are 1.05x+40, 1.10x+60, and 1.15x+90; stacked with Element Atk Up they become 1.15x+40, 1.20x+60, and 1.20x+90. Displayed element is divided by 10. Long Sword spirit-gauge, Charge Blade red-shield axe mode, and Insect Glaive extract bonuses are state-specific and are not permanent class constants. Elemental hitzones and quest-wide defense are separate.
